auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to your madrasa's office
auth.setupSubtitle: First-run setup — this account manages everything on the masjid network.
auth.resetRequestSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If that email is registered, we've sent a link to reset your password. Please check your inbox.
auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been updated. You can now sign in.
auth.adminTunnelNote: Admin sign-in only works on the masjid network. Teachers, finance and parents can sign in from anywhere.
auth.setupOnLanBody: Set up the admin account from a device on the masjid’s own Wi-Fi — for safety, the first admin can’t be created over the internet.
auth.changeSubtitle: Please choose a new password to continue.
auth.parentUsernameIsEmail: Parents: your username is your email address.

home.title: You’re signed in
home.next: Your role’s dashboard arrives in the next steps — attendance, grades, billing and the family portal.

picker.placeholder: Type a name or Student ID…

siblings.title: Any siblings?
siblings.intro: Linking brothers and sisters puts them in one household, so one set of guardian details, one balance and one portal login covers them all.
siblings.contactIntro: {{count}} group(s) share a phone number or email address between their guardians — those are almost certainly siblings, so they’re ticked ready to link.
siblings.surnameIntro: {{count}} group(s) only share a surname. That happens a lot with unrelated families, so nothing is ticked — have a look and tick the ones that really are siblings.
siblings.linkedMerged: Linked {{count}} students, merged {{merged}} duplicate guardian record(s)
siblings.none: Nothing looks like a sibling group right now — every student is either already in a household with their brothers and sisters, or has nothing in common with anyone else on file.
siblings.laterHint: You can always link siblings later from any student’s record.

enrol.title: Enrol students
enrol.hint: Tick everyone who belongs in this class and enrol them in one go. You can still set a class one student at a time on the Students tab.
enrol.currentHint: To take a student out of this class, set their class on the Students tab.
enrol.allPlaced: Every student is already in a class. Switch to “In another class” or “Everyone” to move some here.
enrol.doneSkipped: Enrolled {{count}} student(s). {{skipped}} were skipped — they’re no longer active.

directory.empty: No families yet. Add your first family to get started.
directory.name: Name
directory.feePlanHint: Every student needs a fee plan, so they’re included when invoices are generated.
directory.noFeePlans: Create a fee plan under Billing first.
directory.addSiblingHint: Pick a child who was added separately and they join this household — the guardians and emergency contacts on this record then apply to them too. If they already have siblings on file, those children come across as well.
directory.confirmUnlink: Move {{name}} into a household of their own? Their bills and payments go with them; the guardians stay on this record.
directory.resetNeedsEmail: Add an email address for this guardian first — use Edit.
directory.guardianEditHint: Guardians belong to the family, so this updates them everywhere. Clearing a field removes it.
directory.mailSent: Emailed — the link below is the same one, in case they don’t get it.
directory.mailNoUrl: Not emailed: this app has no public web address yet, so the link would only work on the masjid network. Turn on Remote access for OpenMasjid Students in OpenMasjidOS, or share the link below directly.
directory.mailNoTransport: Not emailed: no email is set up yet. Add SMTP under Settings, or set up email in OpenMasjidOS — or just share the link below.
directory.mailNotSent: Couldn’t send the email. Share the link below instead.
directory.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}} for good? This can’t be undone.
directory.confirmDeleteWithExtras: Delete {{name}} for good? Their fee plan and any charges not yet invoiced go with them. This can’t be undone.
directory.deleteBlocked: {{name}} has already been billed, so their record is part of your invoice history and can’t be deleted. Mark them withdrawn instead — that stops future billing and keeps the record.
directory.deleteBlockedPaid: A payment has been recorded for {{name}}, so their record is part of your payment history and can’t be deleted. Mark them withdrawn instead — that stops future billing. If the payment was really for another child, reverse it under Billing first, then record it against the right one.
directory.idHint: A Student ID is created automatically. To pay at the kiosk or on the donation site, a parent types that ID, checks the name it shows, then can pay for any of their children from there. It’s printed on the statement.
directory.confirmGuardianDelete: Delete {{name}} from this family? Their contact details are removed for good.
directory.confirmGuardianDeleteAccount: Delete {{name}} from this family? They have a parent portal account, and it will be removed too — they won’t be able to sign in, and you’d need to invite them again. Their children, bills and payments are not affected.
directory.confirmGuardianUnlink: {{name}} is also on {{count}} other family, so they’ll only be removed from this one. Their details stay on that other record.
directory.inviteHint: Creates a one-time sign-up link (valid 7 days) — copy it to the guardian. They need an email on file.
directory.mailPaused: Not sent — email to parents is paused in Settings. Use the link below.
directory.confirmWithdraw:
Withdraw {{name}}?

They stop being billed from now on and drop out of the roster and the year view. Their record and their payment history are kept, and you can bring them back at any time.

students.title: Students
students.empty: No students yet — add your first student, or import a CSV.
students.name: Name
students.noSibling: — no, first child in the family —
students.linkSiblingHint: Pick a brother or sister and they share one household, so the guardian details already on file apply to this child too.
students.billFromNoneHint: No invoices are created now. They will be billed from the next time you generate.
students.billFromHint: Creates one invoice per month from then until now, all due today.
students.billedFrom_one: Billed 1 month, starting {{from}}. It is due today and shows on their record.
students.billedFrom_other: Billed {{count}} months, starting {{from}}. They are all due today and show on their record.
students.billedNone_nothing_to_bill: Added, but nothing was billed — this student is on no monthly fee plan, so there was no monthly amount to charge.
students.billedNone_before_floor: Added, but nothing was billed — that month is before the month you started billing from, and those arrears are already in the balance carried forward.
students.billedNone_no_school_year: Added, but nothing was billed — there is no current school year set up, so there are no months to bill.
students.billedNone_future: Added, but nothing was billed — that month has not happened yet. They will be billed when you generate it.
students.billedNone_not_a_month: Added, but nothing was billed — that was not a month this app can bill.
students.billFromEmpty: No earlier months to catch up on — your school year hasn’t started, or you bill from a later month. They’ll be billed from the next time you generate.
students.billFromFutureHint: That month hasn’t started, so nothing is billed now — they’ll be billed with everyone else when you generate it.

import.title: Import students
import.intro: Upload a spreadsheet or CSV and match its columns to the fields below. Nothing is saved until you review the result. Each student becomes one household of their own — link brothers and sisters afterwards, on either child’s record.
import.templateHint: Every column the importer understands, with four example rows showing how a second parent, a sibling discount and a relative are written. Replace them with your own students — an example row left in is refused rather than imported.
import.emptyFile: That file has no rows we could read.
import.matchHint: {{file}} — {{rows}} rows. We guessed these; change anything that looks wrong.
import.idsGenerated: Student IDs are always generated here — they can’t be imported from a file.
import.defaultPlanHint: Used for any row without a Fee plan column. Every student needs a plan, or the row is rejected.
import.siblingsNote: Siblings aren’t worked out from the file — guessing a family from a spreadsheet and getting it wrong would merge two families’ money. Every student becomes their own household, and the next step offers you the likely brothers and sisters to link.
import.siblingsStepIntro: Each of these students is in a household of their own. Link the brothers and sisters now and one set of guardian details, one balance and one portal login covers them all. You can skip this and do it later from any student’s record.
import.siblingsNext: Any siblings you did not link are each in a household of their own. Open one and use Add a sibling whenever you are ready.
import.fixFirst: Fix these rows in the CSV and upload it again — nothing is imported while any row has a problem.
import.idsAssigned: These are the Student IDs each child was given. They’re also on every student’s record and on their family’s statement — and the ID sheet below gives you the whole roster, by class, on one page you can print.
import.pickFileHint: An Excel workbook (.xlsx) or a CSV. Exported straight from your old system is fine — you don’t need to tidy it up first.
import.tooManyRows: That file has {{count}} rows, and an import can take {{max}} at a time. Split it into a few files and import them one after another.
import.extraRowsHint: If your file names a student once and then gives each extra parent or relative a row of their own, those rows are added to the student above them — so a 40-line file can be 25 students.
import.mergedNote_one: {{count}} line had no name of its own, so its contact details were added to the student above it. Check the People column.
import.mergedNote_other: {{count}} lines had no name of their own, so their contact details were added to the student above them. Check the People column.
import.placeContactsIntro: A father or a mother is added as a parent automatically. These relationships could be either — decide once for each and everybody with that relationship follows. A child whose only listed adult is a relative keeps them as a guardian either way, so the household still has somebody the office can contact.
import.asGuardianHint: A parent or guardian appears on the family record, can be invited to the parent portal, and is who you ring about tuition.
import.asEmergencyHint: An emergency contact is just a name, a number and what they are to the child — no portal access, and no email address is kept for them.

file.oldXls: That looks like an older Excel file (.xls). Open it in Excel and use Save As to make a .xlsx or a CSV, then upload that.
file.notZip: We could not read that file as a spreadsheet or a CSV. If it came from another program, export it again as .xlsx or CSV.
file.zip64: That workbook is far larger than a class roster. Save the sheet you need as its own .xlsx or CSV and upload that.
file.noSheet: There are no worksheets in that file — check you uploaded the right one.
file.noInflate: This browser cannot open .xlsx files. Save the sheet as a CSV and upload that instead.
file.tooBig: That workbook is too large to read here. Save the sheet you need as its own file and upload that.
file.compression: That workbook is packed in a way we cannot read. Open it in Excel and use Save As to make a fresh .xlsx or CSV.

import.feesIntro: Every imported student was given the same plan, because a spreadsheet cannot say "the second child pays less". Now that the brothers and sisters are grouped, change anyone’s plan or amount here — and say why, if you have agreed something with the family. Leave the amount at the plan’s own price and they simply follow the plan, including any later change you make to it.
import.feeBadAmount: That amount isn’t a number we can read — try 350 or 350.00.
import.feesLater: You can change any of this later on a student’s own record, or for a whole class at once from Billing.
import.feesUnsaved_one: {{count}} row hasn’t been saved yet — press Save on it, or it won’t be kept.
import.feesUnsaved_other: {{count}} rows haven’t been saved yet — press Save on each, or they won’t be kept.

year.title: Year view
year.noYear: No school year yet. Set one up under Structure, then invoices and this grid line up to it.
year.needsStartYear: “{{label}}” has no starting calendar year, so its months can’t be worked out. Add one under Structure → School years.
year.printPaperHint: Legal paper is recommended — a whole year is wide, and letter closes the columns up.
year.showFeeNote: Show the note next to what a child pays
year.showFeeNoteHint: The note you wrote when you changed a child's fee — “sibling rate”, “hardship”. Turn it off to keep it off this page and anything printed from it.
year.columnsWarning: Extra columns land on this page and on anything you print from it — the contact ones put phone numbers and email addresses on a whole-school sheet, so switch on only what you need. Numbers and addresses are tappable: on a phone, one tap calls or emails. “Other” covers guardians with no relation set, including everyone brought in by a CSV import.
year.legend: ✓ paid · ½ part-paid · ● not paid yet · — voided · blank means no invoice for that month yet. In a dimmed column (before you started billing here) a hollow ✓ was already paid, ○ is still owed in the balance carried forward, and · means nobody recorded either way.
year.beforeStart: This month is before your first billed month, so nothing was ever invoiced for it. Set when you went live (Billing → mid-year setup).
year.hint_settled: The office recorded this month as already paid when the madrasah went live, so nothing was ever invoiced for it here.
year.hint_carried: This month had not been paid when you went live, so it is part of that child’s “Balance carried forward” bill. It turns into a tick once that bill is settled.
year.hint_before: This month is before your first billed month, so nothing was ever invoiced for it. Set when you went live (Billing → mid-year setup).

structure.title: Structure
structure.schoolsHint: Add a second school if your madrasah runs programmes on different calendars — a weekend maktab and a full-time hifz programme, say. Each school gets its own school year and its own classes. Everything else is shared: fee plans, staff, payments, and families. A parent with a child in each still gets one balance and one sheet.
structure.yearsHint: The billing calendar. A madrasa year usually runs across two calendar years — April to March, say — and the months you set here become the columns on the year view and the periods invoices are generated for.
structure.wrapHint: A year that ends before it starts runs into the next calendar year — April to March is twelve months.
structure.termsHint: Only needed if you charge tuition per term. A fee plan set to “per term” is billed on term periods; monthly plans ignore terms entirely.
structure.termsNeedYear: Add a school year first — terms belong to one.
structure.noTerms: No terms — this year is billed by month.
structure.coursesHint: How the roster is grouped. A course holds classes; a student sits in one class. This is for organising and billing only — no teachers, attendance or grades. Until a class exists, every student shows as unplaced.
structure.noCourses: No courses yet. Add one, then add its classes — the Students tab groups by these.
structure.courseArchived: Archived “{{name}}” and its classes. Students in them are now unplaced.
structure.confirmYearArchive:
Archive the year “{{name}}”?

It stops being offered when you generate invoices. Bills already raised are unaffected, since they are filed by month rather than by year.
structure.confirmTermDelete:
Delete the term “{{name}}”?

Anything charged per term has nothing to bill against until you add another. No money is affected.
structure.confirmCourseArchive_one:
Archive the course “{{name}}”?

It disappears from the roster and the year view along with its 1 class. Nothing is deleted and no student loses their record.
structure.confirmCourseArchive_other:
Archive the course “{{name}}”?

It disappears from the roster and the year view along with its {{count}} classes. Nothing is deleted and no student loses their record.
structure.confirmClassArchive_one:
Archive the class “{{name}}”?

Its 1 student is left without a class until you put them in another one — they keep their fees and their history.
structure.confirmClassArchive_other:
Archive the class “{{name}}”?

Its {{count}} students are left without a class until you put them in another one — they keep their fees and their history.
structure.confirmClassArchive_zero:
Archive the class “{{name}}”?

Nobody is in it, so nothing else changes. Nothing is deleted.

mass.title: Mass apply
mass.feeHint: Puts a fee plan on every student you pick. Safe to run twice — a student who already has the plan is skipped, never charged twice.
mass.chargeHint: Adds a one-off line for every student you pick. This is NOT repeat-safe: applying it twice bills twice.
mass.periodHint: Leave “Bill in” empty to put the charge on the next invoice generated for each family; set it to a month like 2026-07 to attach it to that month.
mass.negativeHint: A negative amount is a credit — use it to refund or discount a student without touching an invoice already raised.
mass.noStructure: No courses or classes yet — set them up under Structure, or pick students directly.
mass.feeResult: Assigned to {{assigned}} of {{targeted}}. {{skipped}} already had it.
mass.chargeResult: Charged {{created}} of {{targeted}}. {{attached}} went onto an invoice that was already open; the rest wait for the next generation.
mass.confirmCharge: Charge {{count}} students? This adds a new line each time it runs.

whatsNew.title: What’s new
whatsNew.introRunning: Release notes for OpenMasjid Students, up to the v{{version}} you’re running.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeBody: Manage your madrasa — families, students, classes and records. Pick a section below.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.tempHint: At least 12 characters — changed on first sign-in
staff.resetPwHint: They’ll be asked to choose their own password the next time they sign in.
staff.roleHint: Finance runs billing and can work from home over the internet. Admin can change everything, including settings, and can only sign in on the masjid network. Changing someone’s role takes effect straight away — they don’t need to sign out.
staff.formHint: Enter a username and a temporary password of at least 12 characters.
staff.confirmDisable:
Disable {{username}}?

They are signed out on their next click and cannot sign in again until you enable them. Nothing they have recorded is affected.
staff.waHint: Alerts on their phone as well as by email. Entirely up to them — leave the number blank and they get nothing.
staff.waNotReady: WhatsApp is on, but the gateway isn’t ready yet — check the WhatsApp section in Settings.
staff.waOffHint: You can record a number now. Alerts start arriving once WhatsApp is switched on in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.reachHint: Invites, password resets and receipts all depend on these. If one is missing, the office can still share links by hand — but nothing will be emailed.
settings.reachUrlFrom_env: From the address set when this app was installed.
settings.reachUrlFix: Parents can’t open a link that only works on the masjid network. In OpenMasjidOS, go to Settings → Remote access and turn on sharing for OpenMasjid Students.
settings.reachMailPlatform: Provided by OpenMasjidOS — nothing to set up here.
settings.reachMailFix: This app isn’t connected to OpenMasjidOS yet, so it can’t send email. Invites and resets will be copy/print links until it is.
settings.reachSelfRegBlocked: The setting is on, but sign-up needs both an email set-up and a public web address, because the confirmation link is emailed.
settings.schoolHint: Shown on report cards and statements.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB. Used on printed statements and every email the app sends. A plain logo on a transparent or white background photocopies best.
settings.logoEmailNeedsUrl: Statements will show your logo right away. Emails can only show it once Remote access is on for this app in OpenMasjidOS — an email has to load the image from a web address. Send a test email to see exactly what parents will get.
settings.appearanceHint: Your contact details go on the family information sheet, the statement, and the foot of every email to a parent — so “tell the office” actually tells them how. The date format and colour apply everywhere, printed and on screen.
settings.donatePathHint: The part after your website — /donate, /donations, /tuition. Printed in brackets on the family sheet and the statement so parents know where to go. If your donations page is on a different address altogether, put the whole thing here.
settings.donateUrlNone: Nothing yet — add your website above.
settings.pastDueHint: A bill whose due date has passed. You'll get a summary of who is behind; parents can be reminded automatically too.
settings.pastDueNone: Nobody is past due right now.
settings.pastDueNow_one: {{count}} household is past due — {{amount}} in total.
settings.pastDueNow_other: {{count}} households are past due — {{amount}} in total.
settings.pastDueParentsHint: Off until you turn it on — this app has never sent this before, and switching it on starts writing to real families about money. It's a friendly reminder, and it invites them to speak to the office.
settings.pastDueGraceHint: After the due date, before anything is said.
settings.pastDueEveryHint: Days between reminders to the same family — and between your own summaries.
settings.pastDueRan: Done — {{overdue}} past due, {{emailed}} emailed, {{messaged}} messaged on WhatsApp, {{unreachable}} we couldn’t reach.
settings.noEmailNone: Every family has at least one email address. ✓
settings.noEmailHint: {{students}} students in {{households}} households have nobody with an email address on file, so they get no receipts, no reminders and no portal invite. Ring them and add one.
settings.noEmailNoGuardian: No parent or guardian on the record at all
settings.sheetTextHint: Every sentence on the printed family information sheet, in your own words. The children, the fees and the balances are worked out for you and can't be changed here.
settings.sheetTextTags: Put *stars* around words to make them bold. These fill themselves in: {{tags}} — [names] your children's first names, [is] is/are, [child] child/children, [school] your school name, [website] your tuition page, [date] the date it was printed.
settings.sheetTextClearHint: Clear a box and save to put our wording back in it.
settings.sheetText_feesNone: When no fees are set yet
settings.sheetText_portalSignup: Beside the QR code — when parents can sign themselves up
settings.sheetText_portalInvite: Beside the QR code — when accounts are by invitation
settings.sheetText_payCard: Paying by card in the parent portal
settings.sheetText_payOffice: Cash, check, Zelle or bank transfer
settings.sheetText_payOfficeReceipt: Added to the line above when receipts are emailed
settings.dateFormatHint: Applies everywhere, and to dates you type into a CSV import. Dates are always stored the same way, so changing this is safe.
settings.accentHint: The rules and headings on printed sheets.
settings.logoTooBig: That image is over 512 KB. Export it smaller and try again.
settings.paymentsHint: Choose which of your OpenMasjidOS Stripe accounts tuition is collected into. This is used for card payments in the parent portal and for the tuition option on your donation site and kiosk.
settings.externalPayments: Accept tuition at your donation site & kiosk
settings.externalPaymentsHint: When on, families can pay their balance with their child's Student ID on your masjid's donation site and kiosk. Turn it off to hide tuition there — the parent portal is unaffected.
settings.paymentsNoAccounts: No Stripe accounts found. Add one in OpenMasjidOS (Settings → Payments), then reopen this page.
settings.paymentsNotReady: Card payments aren't ready yet — pick an account above (and make sure it's fully set up in OpenMasjidOS).
settings.meritOnReportCard: Show merit points on report cards
settings.selfRegistration: Let parents sign themselves up (with their child’s Student ID + an on-file email)
settings.selfRegistrationHint: Needs email set up. Turn off to require an office invite instead.
settings.customFieldsHint: Define fields once — they apply to every student’s record (e.g. previous madrasa, juz at intake, walī name).
settings.meritCategoriesHint: Categories teachers award points against, each with a default value (editable per award).
settings.commentBankHint: Reusable remark snippets all teachers can insert into term remarks and report cards.
settings.snippetHint: e.g. Mashā’Allāh, excellent progress this term.
settings.mailTestOk: Sent. If it doesn’t arrive, check the spam folder and the email set-up in OpenMasjidOS.
settings.alertsHint: What the school emails parents, and who at the masjid gets told when something needs a person.
settings.alertsNoMail: Email isn’t set up in OpenMasjidOS yet, so nothing can be sent. These settings are saved and will start working as soon as it is.
settings.parentReceipt: A receipt every time they pay
settings.parentReceiptHint: However the money arrived — in the portal, by autopay, at the kiosk, on the donation site, or cash you recorded here.
settings.parentAutopay: A notice when their card is declined
settings.parentAutopayHint: Sent on each failed autopay attempt, and again when autopay switches itself off after the third.
settings.parentAlwaysHint: Invites and password resets always send — they’re the only way a parent can reach their account. The pause above is the one exception — it holds those too.
settings.staffAlerts: Who to tell at the masjid
settings.staffAlertsHint: Add any address — the treasurer, the imām, a trustee. It grants no access to the app; it only receives the alerts you tick. Alerts can name a household and an amount, so add addresses you trust.
settings.alertAddHint: New addresses start on the alerts that cost money or hide a problem. Tick the rest yourself.
settings.parentMailPauseHint: Nothing at all is sent to a parent while this is on — not receipts, not autopay notices, and not invites or password resets. Turn it on while you are setting up or testing with your real families in the system, so nothing goes out by accident. Staff alerts and your own test sends are unaffected.
settings.parentMailPausedNotice: Email to parents is paused. Invites and resets still give you a link to copy or print, and nothing is being sent.
settings.waHint: Message parents on WhatsApp through your masjid’s own server. It is a short note, not a replacement for email — receipts, invoices and statements still go by email, and nothing to do with signing in is ever sent this way.
settings.waReason_ready: WhatsApp is set up and a phone is linked.
settings.waReason_not-configured: WhatsApp isn’t set up on this server yet. An admin can add it in OpenMasjidOS → Settings → WhatsApp.
settings.waReason_not-linked: WhatsApp is set up, but no phone is linked yet.
settings.waRisk: Worth knowing before you switch this on: WhatsApp does not officially allow this kind of connection, so the linked number can be restricted or banned. OpenMasjidOS spaces messages out to keep that unlikely, and the allowance is shared with every other app on this server — but the risk cannot be removed. Keep email as the channel that always works.
settings.waEnableHint: Off until you turn it on. Nothing is sent to anybody while it is off.
settings.waCountriesHint: A number has to include its country before WhatsApp will take it. Pick the one most of your families are in, and add any others you need — you can then set a different one per parent or staff member.
settings.waAudience: {{reachable}} of {{guardians}} parents can be messaged. {{optedOut}} have asked not to be, and {{noNumber}} have no number on file.
settings.waUnreadable: We can’t read {{count}} number(s) as a WhatsApp number. Usually the country is wrong — set it here and it is fixed for good.
settings.waPause: Pause all WhatsApp messages to parents
settings.waPauseHint: On by default. Turn it off when you have checked the settings and are ready for families to start hearing from you. A test student, below, still gets messages while this is on.
settings.waPausedNotice: Parent messages are paused. Only the test student’s household will receive anything.
settings.waTestStudentHint: This child’s household receives messages and emails even while everything is paused — so you can watch a real one arrive before anyone else does. It changes nothing about their fees or bills. Someone in the office is the right choice.
settings.waTestStudentGone: That student is no longer on the roll, so nothing is getting through the pause. Pick another one.
settings.waTestQueued: Handed to the queue. It will arrive shortly — messages are spaced out on purpose, and held overnight if the masjid has quiet hours set.
settings.waEventsHint: All off to begin with. Each of these is something the app already emails; this adds a short note on WhatsApp as well.
settings.waEvHint_receipt: A short thank-you when money reaches the madrasah, however it was paid.
settings.waEvHint_autopay-failed: When a saved card is declined, and again when automatic payments are switched off after the third try.
settings.waEvHint_past-due: Follows the grace period and cadence you set under Past due, above.
settings.waEmailReq: Ask for a missing email address
settings.waEmailReqNone: Every household has an email address on file.
settings.waEmailReqHint: {{households}} household(s) have no email address, so they get no receipts, invoices or statements. {{sendable}} of them have a WhatsApp number we can reach.
settings.waEmailReqTags: You can use: {{tags}}. Clear the box to go back to our wording.
settings.waEmailReqPreview: See what each family will get
settings.waEmailReqNoAdult: No adult on this household at all — that needs fixing first.
settings.waEmailReqDone: {{queued}} handed to the queue. {{remaining}} still to go — press again another day so the masjid’s number is not sending in bursts.
settings.waEmailReqPaused: Parent messages are paused, so nothing will go out. Turn the pause off above, or set a test student to try it on one household first.
settings.waEmailReqUnreachable: {{count}} of them have no number we can use — those still need a phone call.
settings.waLogHint: Who we handed a message for, and when. Never what it said — a tuition message names a child and their fees. “Queued” means OpenMasjidOS accepted it: it spaces messages out and holds them through quiet hours, so it is not a delivery receipt.
settings.waReasonShort_opted_out: They asked not to be messaged
settings.waReasonShort_http_429: The queue asked us to slow down
settings.waReasonShort_http_403: This app isn’t allowed to send WhatsApp yet
settings.waWordingHint: Our sentences are short on purpose — a WhatsApp is a note, and anything with detail in it goes by email. If your madrasah says it differently, or wants the balance in every message, write your own.
settings.waWordingSample: Previews use the {{family}} household, so you can see the real names and figures.
settings.waWordingUnsaved: Save to see this one previewed.
settings.waWordingClearHint: Clear a box to go back to our wording.
settings.waText_autopay-failed: When a saved card is declined
settings.waText_autopay-stopped: When automatic payments are switched off
settings.waText_past-due: When a balance is past due
settings.waBlocked: Nothing is being sent to parents right now:
settings.waBlock_no_platform: This app isn’t connected to OpenMasjidOS, so it can’t send anything.
settings.waBlock_off: WhatsApp is switched off for this madrasah — the box below.
settings.waBlock_gateway_not-configured: WhatsApp isn’t set up on this server. An admin can add it in OpenMasjidOS → Settings → WhatsApp.
settings.waBlock_gateway_not-linked: WhatsApp is set up on this server, but no phone is linked to it yet.
settings.waBlock_no_events: No message types are switched on — see “What to send” below.
settings.waBlock_paused_no_test: Parent messages are paused, and there is no test student set — so nobody can receive anything.
settings.waOnlyTest: Parent messages are paused, so only the test student’s household will hear anything. Everything else is ready.
settings.waTestDone: Handed to the queue for the test household — {{emailed}} email(s), and WhatsApp: {{whatsapp}}. Messages are spaced out on purpose, and held through the masjid’s quiet hours (9pm–7am unless your admin changed it), so one sent late at night arrives in the morning.
settings.waTestWa_not_ready: not sent (WhatsApp isn’t ready on this server)
settings.waTestWa_opted_out: not sent (they asked not to be messaged)
settings.waTestWa_no_number: not sent (no number we can read)
settings.waEvHint_invoice-ready: When this month’s or this term’s tuition is generated. Once per household, not per child.
settings.waEv_autopay-upcoming: An automatic payment is coming up
settings.waEvHint_autopay-upcoming: Three days before a saved card is charged, so it isn’t a surprise.
settings.waEv_card-expiring: A saved card is about to expire
settings.waEvHint_card-expiring: The month before it expires. This is how automatic payments usually break.
settings.waEvHint_payment-refunded: When money goes back to a family.
settings.waText_invoice-ready: When a new bill is ready
settings.waText_card-expiring: When a saved card is expiring
settings.parentEmail_invoiceReady: Email a parent when a new bill is ready
settings.parentEmailHint_invoiceReady: Off by default. Without it, the first a family hears about a month’s tuition is the reminder that it is late.
settings.parentEmailHint_autopayUpcoming: Three days ahead, so a card charge isn’t a surprise and there is time to move money or turn autopay off.
settings.parentEmail_cardExpiring: Email when a saved card is about to expire
settings.parentEmailHint_cardExpiring: The month before. An expired card is the usual reason automatic payments quietly stop working.
settings.parentEmail_refund: Email a parent when a refund is made
settings.parentEmailHint_refund: A written confirmation, and it sets the expectation that a card refund takes a few days to appear.
settings.waReason_not-permitted: WhatsApp is working on this server, but this app hasn’t been granted permission to use it. That permission travels with the app catalogue entry — if updating OpenMasjid Students doesn’t clear this, the catalogue entry is missing the WhatsApp capability and it has to be fixed there, not here.
settings.waReason_unsupported: This version of OpenMasjidOS doesn’t have the WhatsApp connection yet. Update OpenMasjidOS.
settings.waBlock_gateway_not-permitted: This app isn’t allowed to use WhatsApp — the gateway is fine, the permission is missing from the app catalogue entry.
settings.waBlock_gateway_unsupported: This version of OpenMasjidOS doesn’t have the WhatsApp connection yet.
settings.waGroupsHint: Send staff alerts to a group your admin approved for this app in OpenMasjidOS — a finance group that gets every payment, say. These are the same alerts a staff member can get on their own phone.
settings.waGroupTest: Send a test to this group
settings.waGroupTestQueued: Test handed to the queue for “{{group}}”. Messages are spaced out, and held through quiet hours (9pm–7am by default) — so one sent overnight arrives in the morning.
settings.waGroupDetail: Include family names and amounts in “{{group}}”
settings.waGroupDetailOn: Messages to this group will name the household and the amount — right for a small staff group, wrong for anything wider.
settings.waGroupDetailOff: Messages to this group say what happened and how much, but never who. Turn this on only for a group of staff.
settings.waGroupsParentsHint: Never subscribe a group of parents to these. A family’s balance is their own business, and this app can’t see who is in a group — only you can.
settings.waQueuedMeaning: Messages are paced by OpenMasjidOS to protect the masjid’s number: a gap of a few seconds between each, a cooldown per person, hourly and daily caps, and nothing at all during quiet hours (9pm–7am by default). Anything sent overnight waits until morning.

billing.label: What to call it
billing.recordHint: Recorded against one child — it goes into their balance and covers their oldest unpaid bill first. Anything left over stays as their credit and comes off their next invoice. Paid for two children? Record it twice.
billing.confirmReverse: Reverse this payment? A reversal entry will be added.
billing.noPlansFinance: No fee plans yet — an admin sets these up on the masjid network.
billing.confirmPlanDelete: Delete “{{name}}” for good? It has never been billed, so nothing in your history changes. {{count}} student(s) on it stop being billed for it. This can’t be undone.
billing.confirmPlanArchive: “{{name}}” appears on {{count}} invoice line(s), so it can’t be deleted — your invoice history has to keep meaning what it said. Archive it instead? It disappears from this list and every student on it stops being billed for it; past invoices and payments are untouched.
billing.generateHint: Creates one invoice per student (from their assigned fees) for the month you pick. The tags in the label are filled in from that month, so the wording and the month can never disagree — and what you write here is remembered for next month and for automatic generation. Re-running the same month changes nothing.
billing.reconcileHint: Check Stripe for any card payments that didn't come through automatically — from the donation site, the kiosk, or the parent portal — and record the ones that are missing. This runs on its own each day; use it if a payment seems to be missing.
billing.reconcileDone: Checked {{scanned}} payment(s) — recorded {{recorded}} that were missing.
billing.reconcileUnavailable: Card payments aren't set up yet, so there's nothing to sync.
billing.printInvoiceHint: Print this bill on its own — one child, one period, line by line, on your letterhead.
billing.autoHint: Runs overnight. Only bills months inside your current school year, only once per month, and catches up if the app was switched off on the day. Leave “Due on day” empty for no due date.
billing.autoWhy_no_school_year: No school year is set as current — set one up under Structure first.
billing.autoWhy_needs_start_year: The current school year has no starting calendar year, so its months can’t be worked out. Add one under Structure.
billing.autoWhy_outside_school_year: This month isn’t part of the current school year, so nothing was billed.
billing.autoWhy_too_early: Not yet — it runs on the day you chose.
billing.autoWhy_already_done: This month’s invoices have already been generated.
billing.overrideHint: Charges this student a different amount for the same plan — no need to create another plan. Leave the amount empty to put them back on the plan’s price.
billing.itemsHint: A short list of the things you charge for besides tuition — a uniform, an exam fee, a trip. Applying one copies its name and price onto the charge, so re-pricing an item here never changes a charge already raised.
billing.noItems: No items yet. You can still add a one-off charge without one.
billing.itemEditHint: Changes the price for charges added from now on. Charges already raised keep the amount they were given.
billing.chargeHint: Lands on this period’s open invoice straight away if there is one; otherwise it waits for the next generation. A negative amount is a credit. Once it’s on an invoice it can’t be voided — add a negative charge instead.
billing.findStudent: Search a name or Student ID
billing.nothingDue: Nothing is due for this child right now. Anything you record is held as their credit and the next bill takes it.
billing.nothingDueCredit: Nothing is due — {{amount}} is already in hand for this child, and their next bill will take it.
billing.owesLines: Owes {{amount}} — tick what this payment is for:
billing.tickedHint: {{count}} line(s) ticked, {{amount}}. Recorded against those lines, so they are the ones that show as settled.
billing.familiesMovedHint: Looking for a household? Open the Year tab and press a child’s name — it opens the same record, and shows their class and paid months too.
billing.autopayOn: Autopay is on for this household
billing.autopayOnWith: Autopay is on for this household — {{method}}
billing.autopayOff: Autopay is off for this household.
billing.confirmRemoveFee:
Stop billing {{student}} for “{{name}}”?

Bills already raised are unaffected — this only stops future ones. You can assign it again later.
billing.confirmVoidCharge:
Cancel the charge “{{label}}” for {{amount}}?

It will not appear on any bill. Charges already on a raised invoice cannot be cancelled this way.
billing.confirmVoidInvoice:
Void the bill “{{label}}” for {{amount}}?

The amount stops being owed and the bill is kept, marked void. Only bills with nothing paid against them can be voided.
billing.confirmArchiveItem:
Archive “{{name}}”?

It disappears from the list you apply charges from. Charges already raised from it keep their own label and price.

family.title: Parent Portal
family.subtitle: Your children, balance, and payments
family.kioskHint: At the kiosk or on the masjid’s donation site, type a child’s Student ID and check the name it shows — you can pay for any of your children from there.
family.noFamily: Your account isn’t linked to a family yet. Please contact the office.
family.acceptGreeting: Welcome, {{name}}. Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
family.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Please ask the office for a new one.
family.registerUnavailable: Self sign-up isn’t available yet. Please ask the office for a portal invite link.
family.registerSubtitle: Enter your child’s Student ID, plus an email the school has on file for you. We’ll email you a link to set up your account.
family.registerStudentIdHint: Three letters and four digits, like YUS1234 — it’s on your statement.
family.registerEmailHint: Must be an email the office already has for your family.
family.registerSent: If those details match our records, we’ve emailed you a link to set up your account. Please check your inbox.
family.loadError: We couldn’t load your family right now. Please try again in a moment.
family.orderHint: Autopay charges the first one. If it's declined, we try the next — use the arrows to change the order.
family.payAheadHint: Nothing is due right now. Anything you pay is held on your account and comes off your next invoice automatically.
family.payError: That payment couldn’t be completed. Please try again.
family.paidOptimistic: Payment received — it’ll show on your account in a moment. Thank you.
family.autopayTabSub: Save a card or bank account, and let tuition pay itself
family.expiredHint: A card past its expiry date can't be charged — remove it and add the new one, or autopay will stop.
family.addMethodHint: You can add a card, or a bank account if the madrasah accepts them.
family.methodPending: Added. Your bank still needs to confirm it — check your email for the two small amounts to verify, and it can be used once that is done.
family.paidAhead: paid ahead — comes off your next bill
family.autopaySetUpHint: Save a card or bank account once and tuition pays itself when it’s due.
family.autopayOnCard: We’ll charge your {{card}} when tuition is due.
family.autopayNeedsCard: Add a card or bank account first, then you can switch it on.
family.autopayOn: On — we’ll charge your default payment method when tuition is due.
family.autopayConsent: When on, your default card or bank account is charged automatically when tuition comes due. Turn it off any time.
family.waOptInHint: Short notes about payments and bills, to {{mask}}. Anything with detail in it still comes by email.
family.waNoNumber: No WhatsApp number on file — tell the office and they’ll add one.
family.waHouseholdHint: Everyone on the account can change these, the same way you all see the same bills and cards.

midyear.title: Starting mid-year
midyear.banner: Joining part-way through the year? Record what each child already owes or has paid, in one pass, before you bill your first month.
midyear.step1Hint: Months before this are never billed here — whatever each child brings with them is recorded once, below. This is also how we make sure an earlier month cannot be billed twice later on.
midyear.alreadyFloor: This install already bills from {{period}} onwards.
midyear.needsYear: Set up a school year on the Structure tab first — the months come from it.
midyear.step2: 2. What has each child already paid?
midyear.step2Hint: Pick the last month they are square for — or “Hasn’t paid at all” if they have paid nothing since the year began. We work out the rest from their own rate, including any amount you have agreed just for that child, and if the book says otherwise you can type the figure instead. “Not said” records nothing for them at all.
midyear.step3Hint: Nothing has been written yet. Check the figures above, then apply — each child gets one dated record and billing starts from the month you picked.
midyear.commitHint: Writes one dated record per child and bills from {{period}} onwards.
midyear.doneBody_one: {{count}} child carried a balance forward and {{ahead}} were already paid ahead. Billing starts at {{period}}.
midyear.doneBody_other: {{count}} children carried a balance forward and {{ahead}} were already paid ahead. Billing starts at {{period}}.
midyear.doneSkipped_one: {{count}} child already had a record and was left alone.
midyear.doneSkipped_other: {{count}} children already had a record and were left alone.
midyear.doneNext: Next: generate {{period}} on the Billing tab. Anything earlier is refused, so the balances you just recorded cannot be billed twice.
midyear.searchCount: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} — everyone else keeps whatever you have already set for them.

install.title: Add this to your phone
install.why: It opens like an app, straight to your balance — no address to remember.
install.android2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”

famYear.title: Your year at a glance
famYear.sub: Which months are settled, and which still have something on them.
famYear.none: There is no school year set up yet, so there are no months to show. Everything you owe is on the My family tab.
famYear.cell_settled: Paid — before the madrasah started using this app
famYear.cell_carried: Owed — part of your carried-forward balance
famYear.cell_before: Before the madrasah started using this app
famYear.legend: ✓ paid · ½ part paid · ● still to pay · · not billed yet. A hollow ✓ is a month you had already paid before the madrasah started using this app. If anything here looks wrong, tell the office.

firstRun.ctaBody: There are no students yet. This walks you through everything the app needs before it can bill anybody — your madrasah's name and look, the school year, your classes, what tuition costs, how money arrives, who else works in the office, and the roster — in the order the pieces depend on each other. Every step can be skipped and revisited later.
firstRun.title: First time setup
firstRun.schoolHint: This is the name on every statement, printed sheet and email a parent receives. You can change it any time in Settings.
firstRun.lookHint: Both are used on the family sheet, statements, invoices and every email you send. Neither is required — leave them and the app uses its own.
firstRun.yearTitle: When does your school year run?
firstRun.yearHint: This decides which months the app bills and which columns the Year view shows — April to March, September to June, whatever your madrasah runs. Nothing can be invoiced until one exists, so it is worth two clicks now.
firstRun.termsHint: Only needed if you charge per term rather than per month. A per-term fee has nothing to bill against until the terms exist. Skip this if tuition is monthly.
firstRun.classesHint: A course is a programme — Hifz, Maktab, ʿĀlim. A class is the group a child actually sits in, like Hifz 1. Both are optional, but they are how the roster and the Year view group children, and how a new year moves everyone up.
firstRun.noClassesYet: No classes in this course yet.
firstRun.classesImportHint: Worth doing before the import: if your spreadsheet has a Class or Course column, the importer matches it against the names here and refuses a file naming a class that does not exist yet.
firstRun.feesHint: A fee plan is a name, an amount and how often it is charged — "Monthly tuition, $80, monthly". You assign it to each child afterwards, and you can set a different amount for any individual child, which is how a sibling or hardship rate is handled.
firstRun.feesNeedTerms: You have a per-term plan but no terms are set up, so it will not bill anything. Go back to the School year step and add your terms.
firstRun.feesOverrideHint: Same as the classes above: if your spreadsheet has a Fee plan column, the names have to match the plans here.
firstRun.emailHint: Email is how invites, receipts and overdue reminders reach families. It is set up once in OpenMasjidOS, not here — but it is worth proving it works now, because every one of those messages fails quietly if it is not.
firstRun.emailOkMail: Email is working — invites, receipts and reminders can be sent.
firstRun.emailNoMail: No email yet. Set it up in OpenMasjidOS → Settings, then reopen this page. Until then, parent invites become links you print or hand over.
firstRun.emailOkUrl: Remote access is on, so links in those emails will work from a phone.
firstRun.emailNoUrl: Remote access is off, so the parent portal is only reachable on the masjid's own network and emailed links will not work from outside.
firstRun.emailSent: Sent to {{to}}. Check that it arrived — it looks exactly like a real invite.
firstRun.staffTitle: Who else helps in the office?
firstRun.staffHint: Your own account is already here. Add one for anyone else who needs in — most often a finance manager to handle billing, which is a job you can hand over completely without giving away the settings or the student records.
firstRun.staffPwHint: Generated for you, and only needed once — they choose their own the first time they sign in.
firstRun.staffMade: Account created for {{username}}. Their temporary password is:
firstRun.staffHandover: Write this down or copy it now — it is not stored anywhere and cannot be shown again. If it gets lost, set a new one from the Staff tab.
firstRun.paymentsHint: Choose which of your OpenMasjidOS Stripe accounts tuition is paid into. This covers the parent portal, autopay, your donation site and the kiosk. Skip it if you only take cash — everything else works without it.
firstRun.studentsHint: Import the spreadsheet you already have — an Excel workbook or a CSV. You will match the columns and see exactly what will be created before anything is saved. You can also add students one at a time on the Students tab.
firstRun.studentsReady: Classes set up: {{classes}} · Fee plans set up: {{plans}}. Your spreadsheet's Class and Fee plan columns have to match those names.
firstRun.tourHint: That is setup done. Here is where everything lives.
firstRun.tour_dashboard: Where you are now — headcounts, and a way back into any tab.
firstRun.tour_students: The roster. Add a child, open a household, link brothers and sisters, import a spreadsheet, print Student IDs.
firstRun.tour_year: A whole year at a glance: every student as a row, every month as a column, so you can see who has paid and who has not. Press a name to open their billing.
firstRun.tour_structure: Your school years, courses and classes — the calendar the months and invoices line up to. Set the school year up before generating invoices.
firstRun.tour_billing: The money. Record a cash payment, define fee plans and one-off charges, generate invoices, chase what is overdue, export a spreadsheet.
firstRun.tour_staff: Accounts for the people who help — a finance manager for billing, and parent portal invites.
firstRun.tour_settings: Everything else: your contact details, how dates are written, which emails go out and to whom, the wording on the printed family sheet, and the Stripe account above.

rollover.title: Start a new school year
rollover.noData: Nothing to roll over yet — add a school year first.
rollover.classesHint: Every class either stays as it is, moves its children up into another class, or graduates. We have guessed from the order you put them in — check it, and change any row that is wrong. Expand a class to send one child somewhere different.
rollover.noClasses: No classes yet, so there is nothing to move. You can still open the new year.
rollover.leaversHint: These children finished a class that graduates. Tick anyone who is not coming back — that marks them withdrawn, which stops future billing and keeps their record and their history. Anyone you leave unticked stays on the roster without a class.
rollover.noLeavers: No class graduates this year, so nobody is proposed as leaving.
rollover.leaversNote: A withdrawn student still owes whatever they owed. Nothing about their balance changes.
rollover.feesHint: Change any amount you are raising and leave the rest blank. The plans themselves carry over, and so does every individual amount you have agreed with a family.
rollover.overridesKept: Individual amounts you have set for a child — a sibling rate, a hardship — are kept exactly as they are. Changing a plan only changes what everyone else pays, and only from the next invoice on.
rollover.owingNote: Nothing here changes. These are real unpaid bills and they carry into the new year exactly as they are — this is just so you have seen them.
rollover.confirmHint: Nothing has been saved yet. This is everything that will happen, all at once.
rollover.sumYear: Open {{label}}, running {{from}} to {{to}} from {{year}}, and make it the current year
rollover.sumTerms: Copy {{count}} terms into the new year ({{names}})
rollover.confirmNote: There is no undo for this. Balances and invoice history are untouched.
rollover.doneOwing: Balances from last year are unchanged and still showing. Generate the new year’s first month when you are ready.

refund.title: Refunds
refund.intro: Every payment the madrasah has taken, newest first. A card or bank payment is sent back automatically; cash and checks are put right on the ledger and handed back by you.
refund.searchPlaceholder: A child's name, or how it was paid
refund.none: No payments have been recorded yet.
refund.routeStripe: Goes back to the card or bank account automatically
refund.routeManual: The ledger is put right — you hand the money back
refund.confirmStripe:
Refund {{amount}} back to the card or bank account it came from?

The money leaves the madrasah’s account and the bills it paid become owing again. This cannot be undone here.
refund.confirmManual:
Refund {{amount}} on the ledger?

The bills it paid become owing again. No money moves — you still have to hand it back yourself.
refund.doneStripe: Refunded {{amount}}. It is on its way back to the card or bank account — a bank refund can take a few days to appear.
refund.doneManual: Reversed {{amount}} on the ledger. Remember to hand the money back.
refund.already: That one had already been refunded, so nothing changed.
refund.partialHint: To give back only part of a payment, add a credit on the household’s record instead — that shows on their next bill.
refund.cardsPaused: Card refunds aren’t available at the moment — the connection to your payments account is down. Cash and bank payments can still be reversed here, and card refunds will work again shortly.
refund.carryInHint: A balance carried forward from before you used this app is not listed here — there is no money to send back. Correct it by re-running the go-live step.
